before: Direct native link insertion treated unchanged enclosed controls as edited content. Link removal also treated those controls as restructured content. Derived drawing records omitted their hyperlink envelopes.
after: Direct unstyled link envelopes preserve wholly covered controls. Partial, styled, tracked, and ancestor-protected edits retain existing restrictions. Native wrapper removal preserves descendant controls. Derived drawing formatting carries the existing resolved hyperlink record. The private planner resolves retained atoms to native widths before planning mark and link structure changes.
reason: Stored OOXML, shared messages, and operation shapes do not change. Earlier readers already support hyperlinks containing controls and ordinary native wrapper updates. The new optional link field exists only in derived layout records. Literal linked-mention syntax is private projection data parsed into the existing mention AST; it is not persisted to a room or document.
